newsitem.title: USA: AMAX holders pass financing arrangements.
newsitem.headline: AMAX holders pass financing arrangements.

text.p: AMAX Gold Inc said its shareholders had approved financing arrangements with Cyprus Amax Minerals Co in connection with the restructuring in March 1996 of its $250 million Fort Knox financing and additional financing provided by Cyprus Amax.

It said shareholders authorized payment of fees and interest and repayments of principal in the common stock of Amax Gold, priced at the time of payment. The payments may be made in cash or stock at the option of Cyprus Amax, which owns 51.2 percent of Amax Gold, it added.
Amax Gold produces gold in the United States and Chile and explores for gold in North, South and Central America, Russia, Australia and Africa.
